content.value: Solve ANY THREE of the followings:

(i) Define order of a differential equation with an example. Find the differential equation of $x y = a e ^ { x } + b e ^ { - x } + x ^ { 2 }$ , where $" a "$ and $" \boldsymbol { b } ^ { \flat }$ are arbitrary constants.
(ii) Solve the D.E.; $( 2 x y + 3 y ^ { 2 } ) d x - ( 2 x y + x ^ { 2 } ) d y = 0$
(iii)Solve the D. E., $y ( x y + 1 ) d x + x ( 1 + x y + x ^ { 2 } y ^ { 2 } ) d y = 0$
(iv)Solve the D. E., ${ \frac { d y } { d x } } - y = { x y } ^ { 5 }$
